item.title: GitHub Runner 1.2.1
item.description:
What's Changed

  • Pin the host key for ssh.github.com:443 too (#25) by @SaschaHenning in https://github.com/SaschaHenning/mac-runner/pull/40
  • Edit a scope as a plan: keep, add, re-register, remove (#41) by @SaschaHenning in https://github.com/SaschaHenning/mac-runner/pull/42
  • ci(release): put ~/bin on PATH before notarizing (#43) by @SaschaHenning in https://github.com/SaschaHenning/mac-runner/pull/44

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/SaschaHenning/mac-runner/compare/v1.2.0...v1.2.1
